# q3dresearch/cookbook

> Reproducible recipes that turn public records into findings. Each recipe is
> one question, one method, one figure, and a written account of what the answer
> cannot support. Python standard library only — no dependencies.

Companion to the wss-* archives at github.com/q3dresearch, which capture public
records their publishers overwrite.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to reproduce, verify and extend; inherited failure modes
- [STRUCTURE.md](STRUCTURE.md): repository layout and why
- [VERSIONING.md](VERSIONING.md): method versus data versioning, append-only series

## Recipes
- [uk-company-survival](recipes/uk-company-survival/README.md): the Companies House bulk file
  is a live-register snapshot — DissolutionDate is populated on zero of the first 73,146 rows
  and every status present is one a live company holds, so the register publishes survivors and
  drops its dead. Survival becomes measurable only because the publisher keeps dated monthly
  files nothing links to: a company is dead when it stops appearing. Two-thirds gone within five
  years; agrees with ONS on ordering (rho +0.79) and not on level (below in 11 of 14 sectors);
  449,461 companies at forty formation-agent addresses survive two years at 37% against 56%
  elsewhere, 8.9 points surviving age standardisation, with the two groups indistinguishable in
  2012. Cause is explicitly not claimed: the register carries address and outcome and nothing
  about the relationship.
- [landfill-countdown](recipes/landfill-countdown/README.md): every US municipal landfill in
  one federal file, two editions three years apart. Nationally permitted room rose 14.5bn to
  14.8bn tons after burying a billion, because 1.3bn tons of new capacity went to the states
  with the shortest clocks; eight states have a median site under twenty years; two companies
  own half the remaining room. The register overwrites itself and only the current edition
  resolves, so the interval exists by accident and both workbooks are committed. Promotion
  replaced openpyxl with a stdlib xlsx reader (verified cell by cell, 2,642 rows) and that
  byte-diff exposed a figure that had never been reproducible because it iterated a set.
- [ocean-sampling-effort](recipes/ocean-sampling-effort/README.md): one dataset, fourteen
  figures, five questions. OBIS holds 229,671,953 marine records; 27 of 27,168 grid cells hold
  31.6% and the median cell takes 45% from a single dataset. Two fields that promise and fail:
  the WRiMS introduced flag is species-level so every species sits at exactly 0% or 100%, and
  organismQuantityType is 44 free-text strings reducing to 8 incommensurable kinds. For plants
  and single cells recorded depth is the instrument, rho +0.97 against sequencing share, with
  drill-core forams as the outlier that names the mechanism. A within-stratum composition ratio
  cancels the shared effort and yields one provable cliff at 20/30/50/70 m while three controls
  never cross; it works only where the stratum has many contributors, so the carbonate
  compensation depth is blocked, not negative. A saturating accumulation fit under-predicts
  2024 in 16 of 16 classes — no asymptote, which converts to a price differing 765-fold across
  groups. Taxonomy shows two golden ages and two world wars at -30% and -31%. Threatened species
  are better monitored than a record-count-matched control, 31.4% vs 38.4% unseen; four of five
  IUCN criteria are unreachable and B2 is ruled out for 81% of CR. Wild-capture species are
  detected at +1.04 sd and farmed species are not (p=0.36). The register's ON_LAND flag covers
  52.7% of seabird records and is a habitat map, not an error signature. Traps recorded include
  four parameters that silently return the unfiltered total, a checklist that caps at 10,000 and
  sorts by the variable being modelled, a Darwin Core schema that moved between versions, and a
  join key that matched 0 of 7,517 rows.
- [waste-route-concentration](recipes/waste-route-concentration/README.md): four counting
  artefacts in the EPA hazardous waste register, each generalising past it. The route with the
  fewest firms (deep-well injection, 31) has the lowest Gini (0.63); the one with 77 firms has
  0.98 because one company is 86% of it. Gini across all firms is flat 2001-2023 in every
  route — pin the count at each route's largest 30 and seven of eight concentrate, because
  exits come off the bottom of the distribution. A record count measures filing granularity,
  not activity: one route filed 23.8x the rows on half the tonnage. One plant is 17.0% of every
  ton the country manages. Two figures are replacements for published wrong versions, both
  kept in the write-up.
- [drug-shortage-overlap](recipes/drug-shortage-overlap/README.md): the FDA drug
  shortage register is a §506C compliance feed, not a clinical one — 137 of 196
  substances are permanent discontinuances; one reporting firm predicts an exit at
  95% vs 16%; nothing flagged for paediatric use is being discontinued (0 of 12, 8.6
  expected). Only Australia's register can support a duration and it understates it
  six-fold (median 62 days from resolved rows, 387 corrected for the twelve-month
  purge); no register keeps history. FDA's update_date is reliable (3 silent changes
  in 842) once lists are sorted and the key carries the statutory stream. Supplier
  depth, warning letters, recalls, import alerts, severity, reason codes and
  concentration were tested and failed; five superseded figures kept as worked failures.
- [hf-paper-adoption](recipes/hf-paper-adoption/README.md): which arXiv computing
  papers get adopted by someone who did not write them, and what the Hugging Face
  daily-papers feed does and does not predict about it.
- [dataset-demand-shape](recipes/dataset-demand-shape/README.md): what happens to
  a dataset published on Kaggle. 737,729 datasets; median 8 downloads; 69.5%
  never opened in a notebook; 412,935 with ten downloads or fewer. Size predicts
  use; a sample of already-successful datasets says the opposite.

## Conventions
- provenance.json records corpus hashes and the figures as computed
- history.csv is append-only; method changes are visible breaks, never edits
- if prose and script disagree, the script is authoritative
